label: D2 after choosing a1, strongest when previous trial was unrewarded
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), and almost only when the agent just chose a1 (in_action == 1; 99.9% of activation mass). D2 & a1 alone has recall 1.0 but precision 0.41. Adding prev_reward == 0 (the reward input seen at this trial D1 was 0) gives precision 0.83, F1 0.74, mass recall 0.86 on dev, and it covers nearly all of the top two activation quartiles. Magnitude is largest when a1 follows an unrewarded trial, especially a switch from a2 to a1 (top windows are all a2 -> a1 after no reward, reaching S1 via a common transition). It decays over repeated rewarded a1 trials: weak activations (about 0.05-0.4 of max) remain on a1 trials following rewarded a1 trials, which explains the missed recall. Reaching S1 (common) gives somewhat more activation than a rare S2 outcome. It does not fire after a2 choices. All variables used are observed at D2 (own choice, previous reward).
